decisions.question: SDD pre-flight for nidana.model.9 (spot-check): which model implements each task?

options.label: Sonnet for every task
options.consequence: The run's rule for non-full-review phases; the plan's code was dry-run.

options.label: Opus for Task 3 (multi-input calls and the typed apply closures)
options.consequence: More capable on the subtlest task; departs from the run's rule.

decisions.why: The run's model rule and nidana.model.8's precedent; every Dart block was checked against the dry run.
evidence: docs/auto-run/impl-execution-plan.md How a phase runs item 3

decisions.question: nidana.model.9 Task 3's review found two surviving mutants (a one-input withLatestFrom apply never exercised; a wrong-length check that rejects only too many). The Global Constraints say the phase edits no test file once written. Carry the fix into Task 4?

options.label: Carry into Task 4 as a separate commit editing Task 3's test file, by ruling
options.consequence: Two mutants killed before the final review; one sanctioned deviation recorded in the verification doc.

options.label: Leave to the final review
options.consequence: Cheaper now; the final fix wave would carry a code-adjacent change and a gate re-run.

decisions.chosen: Carry into Task 4 as a separate commit editing Task 3's test file, by ruling
decisions.why: The assertions are three lines and kill mutants the reviewer reproduced; doing it before the final review keeps the final wave doc-only (it was).

decisions.question: nidana.model.9's final review found no code issue and six wording corrections in the verification doc (the amended gate unstated, a miscounted set, an unnamed plan). Fix wave scope?

options.label: One doc-only fix wave; park every code Minor (message grammar, argument position) and route them to nidana.model.11, which edits the DSL library
options.consequence: No gate re-run; the owner signs an accurate doc; two cosmetic code points wait one phase.

options.label: Include the code Minors
options.consequence: Forces a gate re-run and a rewrite of Observed and Metrics for cosmetic changes.

decisions.chosen: One doc-only fix wave; park every code Minor (message grammar, argument position) and route them to nidana.model.11, which edits the DSL library
decisions.why: The reviewer's triage; the gate at 3d9b243 reproduces Observed, so a doc-only wave keeps the evidence true.
